svg.title: Master's research and degree workflow
svg.desc: The main route covers all 13 stages. Decision nodes state when to continue; side branches show where to return if conditions are not met. Solid arrows move downwards, gold diamonds are decisions, and dashed lines return after correction.This is a guide to the work involved. Learning, research and writing may overlap. Formal approval, recognition of outputs and degree conferral follow the rules applicable to you and your institution's decisions. Check separately whether a pre-defense is required and where it falls in relation to screening and thesis review.

text.tspan: The main route covers all 13 stages. Decision nodes state when to continue; side branches show where to return if conditions
